biotools.summary: FreeDTS is a software package for performing mesoscale simulations of biomembranes, enabling research on membrane shape, protein organization, and the effects of membrane proteins. It allows users to model various membrane conditions and integrate vertex-based inclusions to represent membrane proteins.
